reason: The patch makes the team-member builder in handleNewBooking return hardcoded `firstName: ""` and `lastName: ""` (change.patch lines 843-844). `TeamMember` in packages/types/Calendar.d.ts:41-46 only declares name, email, timeZone and language, and the patch does not change that type, so these undeclared empty fields now go out with the team-member objects in the event.
